items.title: A Matter of Stages: Energy-Latency Trade-offs in Multimodal LLM Serving
items.summary: Online serving of multimodal large language models requires deciding whether to separate visual encoding (E), prefill (P), and decode (D) across GPUs and how to configure their frequencies.
